The incumbent reports to the Manager of Finance. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: Last Mile Capacity Planning Specialist, AMZL Capacity Planning
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

A equipe de planejamento de capacidade da AMZL fornece às operações soluções e planos para operações de estações de entrega e frota, durante todo o ano e durante os picos sazonais. O especialista em planejamento de capacidade apoia a execução diária das atividades de gerenciamento de capacidade, trabalhando na definição da capacidade operacional de cada estação de entrega, fazendo o trabalho analítico relacionado à execução e às métricas de capacidade “na estrada” e “sob o teto”. O(a) candidato(a) ideal é apaixonado(a) por usar dados para oferecer um plano prático que impacte os negócios. Ele/Ela têm um forte histórico de entrega de resultados e tem experiência na execução em um ambiente multifuncional, apoiado por análises e dados. Ele/Ela gosta de um ambiente acelerado, trabalhando com grandes quantidades de dados e resolvendo problemas altamente complexos e ambíguos.

Key Job Responsibilities

Como especialista em planejamento de capacidade, você trabalhará no monitoramento de volumes operacionais, trabalhando internamente com equipes da AMZL para garantir a capacidade operacional do plano semanal e diário, e também com outras equipes de transporte e FC para alinhar as configurações de capacidade das estações de entrega em todo o país. Você analisará as lacunas de capacidade versus plano e trabalhará para eliminá-las com as equipes de execução, otimizando o volume das estações de entrega. Você trabalhará em tarefas analíticas, investigando desvios nas premissas críticas de planejamento (pacotes por rota, tamanho médio de pacotes) e fazendo revisões para instruir as operações. Você trabalhará com as configurações de sistemas da Amazon, definindo a capacidade para cada tipo de operação e monitorando a utilização dessa capacidade definida.

O turno de trabalho para esta vaga funciona em escala 5x2, com folgas alternadas em dias de semana e fim de semana. A escala de trabalho é definida de forma o ocupante dessa vaga tenha folga aos domingos a cada 15 dias ou menos, tenha folga de 1 fim de semana inteiro por mês (sábado e domingo) e que não trabalhe mais do que 6 dias seguidos.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os “Amazonians” a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.

A day in the life

  • Trabalhar com equipes da Amazon para transformar inputs de previsão de volume em plano de execução operacional;
  • Interagir com as partes interessadas em toda a malha AMZL para garantir que a execução do plano diário;
  • Apoiar a liderança com análises de dados importantes para garantir uma tomada de decisão rápida e precisa.

About the team

O Amazon Logistics (AMZL) é o serviço de entrega “Last Mile” da Amazon, responsável por entregar pacotes (e sorrisos) para residências e empresas em todo o planeta. Na AMZL Brasil, a equipe de Planejamento e Expansão (P&E) supervisiona três áreas principais de apoio à operação e crescimento da AMZL: (1) Planejamento e gerenciamento da jurisdição, impulsionando o crescimento e a otimização de nossa cobertura e topologia de entrega/coleta; (2) Planejamento de capacidade, garantindo capacidade adequada em curto/médio/longo prazo para maximizar a obtenção de volume dentro da jurisdição da AMZL; e (3) Iniciativas de expansão, coordenando esforços locais em projetos “grandes” que permitem novos tipos de operações, novos canais de vendas e entrega (tipos de frota, micromobilidade) e coordenação programática de ponta a ponta da expansão da rede da AMZL.

Qualifications

  • Graduação Completa;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Excel, incluindo: tabelas dinâmicas, macros, índice/correspondência, vlookup, VBA, links de dados, etc.
  • Conhecimento em SQL ou outras linguagens de programação de dados.

Job Title: Business Development Representative (BDR)

Location: Remote

Department: Sales

Reports To: VP of Growth

Company Overview

Founded in early 2002, viaPeople set out to redefine the human resources software industry by adopting a unique business model. Unlike competitors that offered one‑size‑fits‑all solutions, we committed to developing best‑of‑breed products tailored to the distinct needs of our clients. Our approach combines expert‑driven design with exceptional flexibility to address even the most complex requirements, all while maintaining a steadfast focus on product excellence, relationship management, and superior service quality.

With over two decades of experience in optimizing people management, viaPeople delivers bespoke HR software solutions that adapt to client needs, supported by a reliable and responsive vendor. Our offerings include performance management, succession planning, and 360‑degree feedback solutions, all backed by an exceptional level of service.

Job Overview

The Business Development Representative (BDR) will be responsible for maintaining and scaling viaPeople’s sales engine. This role sits at the intersection of sales development, lead operations, and sales analytics.

You will own lead ingestion, enrichment, and sourcing efforts while partnering closely with sales leadership to ensure pipeline health, data quality, and visibility into performance. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, data‑oriented, and motivated by building systems that enable consistent outbound success.

This is a foundational role on the growth team with clear exposure to sales strategy, tooling, and performance metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Development & Lead Sourcing

  • Own inbound lead intake, qualification, routing, and enrichment
  • Proactively source new leads through research, outbound prospecting, and targeted account lists
  • Support outbound campaigns via email, LinkedIn, and other prospecting tools
  • Identify ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and buying personas in partnership with sales leadership

Sales Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and enriched CRM data
  • Ensure lead and account records are consistently updated and standardized
  • Track funnel performance from lead to opportunity
  • Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and drop‑off points in the sales process

Reporting & Dashboards

  • Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting to track:
    • Lead volume and source
    • Conversion rates
    • Pipeline coverage
    • Activity metrics
  • Provide regular reporting and insights to sales leadership
  • Support forecasting and pipeline reviews with accurate data

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Leadership to align on pipeline goals
  • Provide feedback on lead quality and campaign effectiveness
  • Support Account Executives by ensuring qualified, well‑researched leads

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent experience)
  • 3 years of experience in BDR, SDR, sales operations, or revenue operations roles
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic reporting
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑moving, early‑growth environment
  • Interest in B2B SaaS, HR technology, or sales operations is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: Competitive Compensation Package
  • Bonus: Performance‑based bonus tied to pipeline and data quality metrics
  • PTO: Generous unlimited PTO and holiday schedule
  • Growth Opportunity: Direct exposure to sales strategy, tooling decisions, and leadership

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to ensuring viaPeople’s sales team operates with clarity, consistency, and momentum. You’ll help power the front end of the revenue engine while providing the insights leadership needs to scale efficiently.

title: E-Commerce & Marketing Manager
description:
Sofitel

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought‑after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir‑faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free‑minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

Our Brand

With over 115 Sofitel and Sofitel Legend hotels in more than 45 countries, our reach is truly global, making the sky the limit for growth opportunities. As our portfolio expands each year, there are ample opportunities to be involved in both our existing properties and our future openings.

Our Hotel

As a landmark for Sofitel in the Americas, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema re‑emerges as a revitalized beachfront icon where French elegance meets the vibrant Carioca lifestyle. Designed as a sanctuary of art, craftsmanship, and sensory experiences, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in Rio de Janeiro.

The property features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy elevated dining on the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in.

The design vision is led by Brazilian architect Patricia Anastassiadis, whose storytelling approach blends heritage, artistry, and contemporary sophistication, creating spaces that feel both meaningful and deeply connected to place. Set beneath the iconic Christ the Redeemer, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema stands as the ultimate destination for discerning travelers—where luxury meets the true soul of Rio.

Position

As our E-Commerce & Marketing Manager , you are the hotel’s digital and brand positioning architect. This role elevates the hotel’s visibility across all digital touchpoints, drives direct revenue growth, and safeguards brand integrity in alignment with Sofitel standards. As a key member of the Commercial Leadership Team, this role reports to the General Manager and combines strategic vision with analytical rigor, ensuring the hotel is positioned as a preferred destination for discerning travelers, meetings, and social events.

What You Will Do

Digital Strategy & Direct Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive e‑commerce strategy to maximize direct bookings and optimize digital conversion
  • Drive performance across brand.com, OTA channels, luxury consortia platforms, and paid media
  • Oversee website content, digital platforms optimization, booking engine performance, and SEO/SEM initiatives
  • Manage digital campaigns with a strong ROI focus, including paid search, display, retargeting, and metasearch
  • Monitor digital KPIs (conversion, traffic, pace, channel mix) and provide actionable insights

Brand & Positioning

  • Protect and elevate the hotel’s luxury positioning across all digital and print platforms
  • Ensure all content reflects the hotel’s identity, storytelling, and service ethos
  • Collaborate with global/brand teams to ensure compliance with brand standards and campaigns
  • Lead content creation including photography, video, social storytelling, and partnership activations

Social Media & Content Marketing

  • Curate a refined and aspirational social presence aligned with luxury traveler expectations
  • Develop an annual content calendar supporting key revenue periods, F&B activations, spa offerings, and seasonal experiences
  • Foster influencer, media, and strategic partnerships that enhance brand visibility

Performance Marketing & Analytics

  • Own monthly digital performance reporting and budget tracking
  • Analyze market trends, competitive positioning, and customer behavior
  • Identify new digital opportunities to enhance share of voice and market share
  • Work closely with Revenue Management to align digital strategy with pricing and demand periods

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue, and Operations to support need periods, group campaigns, and F&B initiatives
  • Support hotel’s pre‑opening positioning strategies
  • Act as the hotel’s digital champion, driving innovation and best practices

Qualifications

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years in luxury hospitality marketing, e‑commerce, or digital commerce
  • Proven track record driving direct revenue, digital campaigns, and brand.com performance
  • Experience with booking engines, OTAs, digital distribution, loyalty programs, and CRM campaigns
  • Analytical expertise in KPIs, revenue performance, and campaign ROI
  • Luxury brand sensibility with strategic commercial acumen
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; French is a plus
  • Multi‑property or pre‑opening experience is advantageous

Additional Information

How You Will Shine

  • Express entrepreneurial spirit and leadership while embodying the French Art de Vivre
  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir‑faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main)
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others
  • Exhibit a strong sense of luxury by creating meaningful stories, rituals, and traditions
  • Embrace a true Francophile mindset, showing curiosity and appreciation for French language, culture, history, and cuisine
  • Demonstrate open‑mindedness, creativity, and a spirit of innovation
  • Act as a cultural link by engaging with local arts, gastronomy, fashion, and contemporary design
  • Champion committed luxury with a strong sense of care and responsibility

Sobre a Passarelli

Há mais de 90 anos transformamos vidas através da engenharia. E agora, queremos você para fazer parte dessa história de sucesso! Na Passarelli, somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e acreditamos que a engenharia pode transformar vidas. Com mais de 90 anos de história, construímos um legado de inovação, ética e compromisso. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho humanizado, onde cada profissional é parte essencial do nosso sucesso.

Por que se juntar a nós

  • Inovação e Tradição: projetamos o amanhã com a solidez de quem tem décadas de experiência.

  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Engenharia, RH e Operações na gestão de riscos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho com registro no MTE;
  • Interpretação das Normas OHSAS 18001, NBR ISO 9001 e NBR ISO 14001;
  • Desejável ter conhecimentos em primeiros Socorros;
  • NR’s que regulamentam a Segurança do Trabalho nas empresas;
  • Resgate em altura / espaços confinados;
  • Pacote Office (básico).

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
When defining the purpose of a job it is helpful to consider questions like:

  • In what way does it contribute to the value of company?
  • What part of the organisation’s or team’s total purpose is accomplished by people in this job?
  • What is the unique contribution of this job that distinguishes it from other jobs?

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES’s Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES’s growing network and datacenter presence around the world. You will lead and assist with various projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, security, VoIP, and multi-media services including inflight entertainment. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc.
  • Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity.
  • Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices.
  • Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation.
  • Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices.
  • Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-7 years’ hands‑on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware.
  • Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS‑XE, and NX‑OS, PAN‑OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command‑line interfaces.
  • Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking.
  • Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD‑WAN)
  • Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi‑data center environments
  • Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high‑throughput applications.
  • Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy
  • Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus
  • Hands‑on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis.
  • In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access.
  • Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192.
  • Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus
  • Racking various types of networks and server equipment.
  • Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

  • PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

  • Apoiar nos projetos de abastecimento de água e transporte de esgoto;

  • Conhecimentos Técnicos de Hidráulica de redes pressurizadas.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos de Sistemas de abastecimento de água.
  • Habilidade de Leitura e interpretação de curvas de perda de carga.
  • Instrumentação de campo (medidores de vazão, pressão, dataloggers).
  • Conhecimeto de Softwares de modelagem hidráulica (EPANET, InfoWater, WaterGEMS).
  • Noções de GIS.
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;
  • Auxilio creche para as mães;
  • Empréstimo consignado em folha;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

O time de Agents Growth atua na aquisição e engajamento dos nossos parceiros e corretores. Acabamos de passar por uma reestruturação e buscamos um(a) Especialista de Negócios para atuar diretamente com a liderança da área, sendo a verdadeira "fonte da verdade" dos nossos indicadores de performance. O seu maior desafio será encontrar o equilíbrio perfeito entre uma altíssima capacidade técnica de manipular dados e um aguçado Business Sense, traduzindo números complexos em ações claras para o negócio.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar de forma estratégica e generalista apoiando o funil de aquisição de parceiros, garantindo a consistência dos controles e indicadores.
  • Colocar a mão na massa (hands‑on) para estruturar dados hoje desorganizados ou de fontes não oficiais.

  • Evoluir processos analíticos acompanhando as mudanças no sistema e no roadmap de produto.

Requisitos:

  • SQL Avançado (Obrigatório): Você precisa ter autonomia total para criar queries, conectar tabelas de diferentes fontes e realizar modelagens complexas.
  • Business Sense afiado: Capacidade comprovada de não apenas extrair dados, mas transformá-los em estratégia.
  • Experiência robusta com manipulação de grandes volumes de dados não estruturados.
  • Resiliência, jogo de cintura e alta capacidade de adaptação para lidar com processos em construção.

Importante

  • O nosso processo seletivo começa na candidatura! Se você está realmente a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, foque nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno para todas as pessoas que investiram tempo em se candidatar.

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem‑vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. O Técnico de Enfermagem exerce atividades relacionadas aos cuidados de enfermagem de média e pequena complexidade, auxiliando a equipe de saúde na execução dos trabalhos em nível hospitalar, com foco no cumprimento da prescrição de enfermagem.

Realizar procedimentos gerais e específicos de enfermagem, tais como: prestar assistência aos pacientes através de cuidados de higienização, auxílio a alimentação, verificação de glicemia capilar, terapias de suporte respiratório (micro e macro nebulização), aspiração de vias aéreas, manipulação de sondas e drenos, efetuando a limpeza e a desinfecção de materiais utilizados pelos pacientes, preparando corpo pós-morte, prestando assistência contínua aos pacientes em cuidados no fim da vida e sedação controlada, administrando medicamento via oral, endovenoso, intramuscular e subcutâneo, observando horários e posologia conforme a prescrição médica, a fim de obter o equilíbrio clínico dos pacientes;

Receber e passar plantão junto à equipe de enfermagem, tomando e/ou dando ciência de todas as anormalidades e eventuais ocorrências no período, com objetivo de garantir a comunicação efetiva para continuidade do cuidado;

Coletar materiais para análise laboratorial, identificando-os e encaminhando-os aos laboratórios específicos, a fim de que sejam efetuadas as devidas análises;

Controlar e/ou efetuar desinfecção de materiais utilizados nos procedimentos através de técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção;

Participar de treinamento em serviço, a fim de garantir a atualização científica na área, garantindo a qualidade da assistência de enfermagem e a segurança do paciente.

Realizar limpeza de utensílios de banho (comadres, patinhos, balde, jarra, bacias), e de terapia respiratória que serão enviados para reprocessamento, através de técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção.

Formação Técnica em Enfermagem;

Desejável experiência na função.

Administração de medicamentos;

Saúde do Idoso.

Organização;

Diagnosticar, planejar, propor e executar intervenções voltadas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades de linguagem e comunicação em crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), atuando em equipe interdisciplinar e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e o bem‑estar dos aprendizes neurodiversos.

Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar

  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe interdisciplinar possam ter sobre nosso trabalho.

Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico

  • Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.

  • Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.

Intervenção

  • Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa.
  • Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz.
  • Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados.

Coordenação, Monitoramento e Trabalho em Equipe

  • Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica.
  • Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar.

  • Formação em intervenção motora da fala (PROMPT, DTTC, REST) e CAA (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) e TEA.
  • Cursos complementares em Motricidade Orofacial e TEA (diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

  • Experiência anterior de 6 meses na área.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host City Manager – Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines. The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas. The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities. The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília. Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differentials

Requirements

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (NGL) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

You will be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie") , one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.

Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.

The Mission

Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.

This role is measured in metrics shipped , not features shipped.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

This role reports directly to the General Manager – NGL and operates as the single‑threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross‑functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data , and you will own feature rollout end‑to‑end in partnership with Engineering.

What You’ll Do

  • Monetization Systems
    • You own all product‑led revenue systems:
      • Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
      • Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
      • One‑time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
      • Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
      • Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
      • Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
      • Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
    • You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
  • Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
    • NGL is creator‑driven. You own:
      • Influencer onboarding flows
      • Creator‑specific product surfaces and incentives
      • Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
      • Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
      • Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
    • Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel.
  • Funnel Ownership (End‑to‑End)
    • You own the full lifecycle:
      • Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
      • First‑session experience and activation
      • Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
      • Re‑engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
      • Conversion to paid
      • Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
      • Retention, churn reduction, and win‑back flows
    • You are expected to know where every drop‑off lives.
  • Experimentation & Growth Velocity
    • You will:
      • Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
      • Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
      • Test influencer‑specific monetization strategies
      • Kill underperforming ideas quickly
      • Scale winners aggressively
      • K‑Factor Optimization
    • Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection.
  • Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
    • You own feature execution end‑to‑end:
      • Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
      • Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
      • Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
      • Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
      • Monitor post‑launch performance and iterate fast
    • You ship, measure, and refine. No throw‑it‑over‑the‑wall handoffs.
  • Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
    • You will:
      • Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
      • Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
        • Revenue performance
        • Funnel metrics
        • Experiment results
        • Key risks and opportunities
        • Provide data‑backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
      • The GM should never be surprised by the numbers

Success in This Role Means

  • You are directly accountable for:
    • Paid conversion rate
    • ARPU / LTV
    • D7 / D30 retention
    • Revenue by acquisition source
    • LTV / CAC and payback period
    • Experiment velocity

What You Bring to the Team

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
  • Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
  • Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one‑time purchases
  • Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
  • Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
  • Proven track record running high‑velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
  • Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end‑to‑end
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
  • Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
  • A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
  • Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
  • Experience in creator‑driven or social products preferred
  • Experience optimizing K‑Factor and viral loops preferred
  • Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic . Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people – collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
  • Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
  • Work with a global, top‑tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
  • Shape the next stage of a high‑growth social platform , entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.
  • Grow inside a fast‑growing, post‑acquisition business backed by strong leadership and investment in monetization, UA, and product innovation.
  • Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparent collaboration.

We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule

What We Are Offering

  • We are a 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full‑time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonusly – We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full‑time team members).

If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together!

We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Investment Director Climate Investor 2
description:
Climate Fund Managers B.V. (CFM) is a leading blended finance fund manager dedicated to securing a sustainable future by investing across global emerging markets. CFM has a long-term vision to structure cutting edge financing facilities around thematic areas of climate change mitigation and adaptation, including renewable energy, water and oceans, sustainable land use, and sustainable cities. CFM is established as a joint venture between the Dutch development bank FMO and Sanlam InfraWorks – part of the Sanlam Group of South Africa with offices in The Hague, Cape Town, Windhoek, Singapore and Bogota.

CFM is subject to supervision by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (Autoriteit Financiële Markten or “AFM”) and/or the Dutch Central Bank (De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. or “DNB”) and is authorised to act as investment manager (beheerder ).

Job Purpose

We are seeking an Investment Director to strengthen our Investments and Asset Management team. This role will report to the Regional Head of Latin America and will be ideally based in Brazil (Sao Paulo (preferred) or Rio de Janeiro). The Investment Director will interface CFM divisions and offices.

As a leader in the sustainable finance sector and a pioneer in the renewable energy, water sanitation, oceans infrastructure and green hydrogen sectors, CFM is committed to driving positive environmental impact through strategic investments in climate-related projects. The Investment Director will play a pivotal role in originating and executing on our investment strategies, managing a portfolio of water sanitation, waste valorisation opportunities and oceans infrastructure assets, contributing to the transformation of the LatAm economy and the transition to a more sustainable future.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Management and execution of CI-2 / Climate Investor Two Fund Managers Investment and Fundraising Strategy: Originate investment opportunities that align with the fund’s climate objectives, with a particular emphasis on all themes relevant in the Brazilian market that are in alignment with the CI2 mandate primarily namely water sanitation, waste transformation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm, taking into consideration ESG factors and the potential for positive environmental impact.
  • Portfolio Management: Invest and manage a diverse portfolio of water and sanitation and oceans infrastructure assets with a focus on strategic projects to CFM in Brazil.
  • Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, assessing financial viability, evaluating technology readiness, environmental sustainability, market potential and key risk factors, supported by the regional Latam team.
  • Deal Structuring: Collaborate with the broader investment team to structure deals, negotiate terms, and secure financing for water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm.
  • Risk Management: Monitor and mitigate risks associated with water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure investments, implementing strategies to preserve capital and maximize returns.
  • Impact Measurement: Maintain robust impact measurement frameworks to track and report on the environmental benefits of investments.
  • Stakeholder Relations: Foster strong relationships with project developers, partners, and stakeholders in the water, sanitation, and oceans infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Compliance: Ensure investments are compliant with all regulatory and ethical guidelines, staying up to date with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Fundraising and growth opportunities: Identify and highlight opportunities to seek new capital investors that may align with CFM’s products and growth strategies and support any such initiatives as requested.
  • Team Management: Provide management, mentorship, and guidance to junior investment professionals, promoting a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment as it may be relevant, while interacting closely with other Latam team members based in the region.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Chartered Accountant, CFA or Engineer with MBA or equivalent master’s degree.
  • A minimum of 15‑years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance with a strong track record in deal structuring and financial reporting in the Renewable Energy, Water, Waste to Energy and Oceans Infrastructure sector.
  • Strong analytical, communication and negotiation abilities.
  • English and Spanish language proficiency in addition to native Portuguese.
  • Proven ability to work across technical/financial and legal aspects of a transaction and work with various specialists internally and with government/shareholder/lender type stakeholders to provide transaction leadership.
  • Knowledge of relevant regulations and ESG Principles, compliance requirements, including but not limited to IFRS standards.
  • Ability to plan and prioritise effectively: strong project / process and team management skills.
  • Ability to apply sound business judgment and an analytical, pragmatic, and creative approach to problem solving.
  • Technically proficient (Advanced) in Excel, Word, PowerPoint essential.
  • Experience and significant proven track record of working in Brazil and other LatAm jurisdictions.
  • Work permit and residency in Brazil.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Result-oriented – Being focused on achieving objectives and results, persevering in the face of adversity.
  • Devotion to quality – Demanding a high quality on outputs and acting accordingly.
  • Planning – Systematically organizing activities and setting time frames, setting priorities.
  • Initiative – Identifying opportunities or solutions, and taking action.
  • Analysing and forming opinions – Being focused on examining matters in a systematic way.
  • Cooperation – Working with others in order to effectively contribute to a common objective.
  • Situational Awareness – Being well informed about developments in one's environment and effectively using this information for one's own organisation.
  • Performance under pressure – Maintaining an effective performance under pressure, or when faced with setbacks or disappointment.

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.

Core Competencies

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Who We Are (Mode Mobile)

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones." This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc. We enable users to profit from their data and attention rather than letting only tech giants benefit. Our inclusive approach sets us apart – converting users into earners and facilitating over $150M in earnings and savings while going a step further and turning earners into owners by awarding stock ownership in Mobile Mobile based on their usage. We have attracted over 40 million users across 170 countries.

Mode Mobile is proud to stand as the #1 Fastest‑Growing North American Software Company recognized in Deloitte's 2023 Technology Fast 500 and ranked #2 across all sectors.

For additional insights, check out the information about our reward‑based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine behind our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

The Role

We’re seeking a highly analytical and performance‑driven User Acquisition Manager to lead and scale paid acquisition efforts across Mode Mobile's consumer app portfolio. This role will focus on executing and optimizing campaigns across major mobile and web channels to drive efficient, profitable user growth.

The ideal candidate is a data‑driven performance marketer with strong mobile UA fundamentals, a test‑and‑learn mindset, and experience scaling spend while maintaining healthy CAC, ROAS, and LTV metrics across diverse audiences and geographies.

  • Hands‑on performance buying
  • Strong analytical rigor and experimentation discipline
  • Experience working with creative teams and external partners
  • Solid understanding of mobile growth and monetization mechanics

You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Monetization, and Creative teams, as well as Mode Mobile's centralized UA and Growth function, to deliver sustained user and revenue growth across multiple products.

Who You Are and What You'll Do

  • Plan, launch, and optimize UA campaigns across core paid channels: Meta, Google, TikTok (SRNs/SANs), Programmatic DSPs, Rewarded Ad Networks, and more
  • Responsible for daily performance tracking, pacing, and spend efficiency against KPIs (e.g., CPI, CPA, ROAS) of your campaigns
  • Manage and scale daily spend while maintaining efficient CAC, ROAS, and LTV targets
  • Run ongoing A/B and multivariate testing across creatives, formats, messaging, and funnels
  • Analyze campaign performance data to surface insights and optimization opportunities
  • Partner with creative teams to develop, test, and iterate on high‑performing ad concepts
  • Stay current on UA trends, platform changes, attribution updates, and emerging channels
  • Contribute to the evolution of Mode's growth playbook, including testing new channels, formats, and markets
  • This is an individual contributor role managing the UA efforts for the Mode Earn App and other apps, with frequent opportunities for cross‑functional collaboration, partnering with product, data analytics, and design to improve funnel performance.

What You Bring to the Team

  • 1‑4 years of hands‑on mobile UA buying for consumer apps, games, utilities, or subscription products. Ideally, experience with In‑app ads monetized products
  • Proven experience managing Mobile App campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok (SRNs/SANs), Programmatic DSPs, Rewarded Ad Networks, and more
  • Strong analytical skills fluent in Excel/Sheets and familiar with tools like MixPanel, Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau, Singular (BI Tools & Attribution Frameworks)
  • Experience with MMPs and performance marketing attribution
  • Experience collaborating cross‑functionally with Product, Monetization, and Creative teams
  • Strong communication and reporting skills with the ability to clearly articulate insights and recommendations
  • Bonus: Experience with ASO, web‑to‑app flows, rewarded traffic, or viral growth strategies
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the "why," learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You’re a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic – collaborative, humble, hungry, and invested in each other’s success
  • Make an impact across a global portfolio of consumer apps with meaningful scale
  • Work with a top‑tier, globally distributed engineering and growth team
  • Help shape and scale high‑growth products through their next phases of monetization and expansion
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas move fast, and impact is visible
  • Grow within a fast‑growing company backed by strong leadership and continued investment
  • Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparency

We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule

What We Are Offering

  • We are a 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full‑time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonusly – We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full‑time team members).

title: Montevideo Development Graduate Programme
description:
Based in Montevideo, the two-year Development Graduate Programme offers, 3 × 8 month rotations, across Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance in Energy or Metals and Minerals.

Throughout the programme, graduates gain practical experience and exposure to the full trade lifecycle, working at the core of our operations. By building expertise across these critical functions, graduates develop a strong foundation for success in high-impact middle office roles in Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance and are well-positioned to grow into future leadership positions.

Guided by some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, graduates receive ongoing support and development opportunities, providing them with the skills, mindset and confidence to help shape the next chapter of our business.

Deals Desk

Deals Desk is responsible for accurate mark-to-market valuation, daily P&L and risk and exposure reporting. Deals Desk is an independent control function that works closely with commercial, middle and back office teams to ensure timely trade capture and effective management of trading positions in our trading and risk management systems.

Responsibilities

  • Reviewing and verify trades and trade terms
  • Producing daily P&L and exposure reports
  • Liaising with traders, operations and finance to reconcile positions
  • Investigating and resolving trade discrepancies

Operations

Operations coordinates the physical movement and delivery of commodities, ensuring contracts are executed efficiently and profitably.

Responsibilities

  • Managing vessel or land logistics and documentation
  • Liaising with counter parties and terminal
  • Tracking cargo movements and inventories
  • Ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Trade Finance

Trade Finance designs and implements the financing solutions that enables the physical movement commodities, while managing credit and performance risks.

Responsibilities

  • Structuring and executing real-world commodity trade finance deals
  • Drafting, negotiating and managing trade documents such as letters of credit, guarantees and receivables financing
  • Monitoring global trade flows, payment schedules and risk exposure across complex transactions
  • Collaborating with traders, operations, credit teams and banking partners to resolve day-to-day financing and logistics challenges

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • 0-2 years of postgraduate working experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish - both oral and written
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, passion, motivation and grit
  • Ability to remove roadblocks and break down barriers to get the job done
  • Passion for working in a collaborative, challenging and dynamic environment
  • A global, innovative mindset

description:
Company Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing, and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Network teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery, network design, integration, and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments and responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment and understand end-to-end system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define quality and performance indicators
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Service & resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Maintain close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap and be responsible for necessary software/hardware upgrades during component lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross-team processes
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

About You

  • Proven experience implementing live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience designing, testing and operating signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects, SIGTRAN and DIAMETER based, using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and respective reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS architecture, including Application Servers and interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience of Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks, from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network error/problem for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days maternity leave and 20 days paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance — provided to mothers with children under 3 years old, R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities — Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure — Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team — From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment — Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development — Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience — Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture — Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude — Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking an operational auditor with substantial auditing or operational experience in Upstream or Downstream to join Internal Auditing Organization.

The Internal Auditing is responsible for helping organizations to accomplish their objectives by bringing a systematic and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the organization’s risk management, control, and governance processes.

Your primary role will be to lead and oversee the audit team while serving as the primary liaison for clients, ensuring strong relationships and high-quality delivery throughout the engagement.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Establish the objective and scope of the audit engagement.
  • Identify key risks and controls within the business and operational processes under review.
  • Develop comprehensive risk-based audit programs.
  • Responsible for the audit team and will be overseeing assistant auditors.
  • Discuss concerns and issues with the audit client, draft field memorandums, and update client and Internal Auditing Management on progress of the audit.
  • Execute risk-based audit procedures in alignment with company policies and international standards.
  • Deliver presentations to client management at the audit opening and closing meetings.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Evaluate the performance and capabilities of the assisting staff auditors.
  • Provide assurance and consulting activities on internal controls as requested.
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, or another related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 7 years of experience in auditing, engineering, or plant operations within the oil and gas industry or from one of the Big Four Auditing firms (Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG)
  • You should hold at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Public Accountant, Chartered Accountant, or a similar professional credentials.
  • You must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in the English language and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be flexible to travel within the Kingdom and/or outside the Kingdom to conduct audit and consulting engagements.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

description:
Descrição

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Registro em conselho: Coren ativo e em dia.
  • Experiência: Desejável experiência anterior na função/setor.

Atividades

  • Realizar todas as atividades mantendo o alinhamento às premissas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Prestar assistência aos pacientes, bem como supervisionar e orientar os Técnicos de Enfermagem nas atividades desenvolvidas junto aos pacientes, de modo a aplicar e observar as técnicas e procedimentos utilizados, conforme o quadro clínico do paciente;
  • Identificar e intervir frente aos sinais e sintomas de urgência/emergência e de deterioração clínica;
  • Estabelecer uma dinâmica de trabalho que garanta a continuidade do atendimento nos diferentes espaços de trabalho;
  • Interpretar e realizar intervenções a partir dos achados hemodinâmicos; identificar e implementar plano educacional para pacientes e familiares;
  • Manter constante comunicação com a Equipe Multidisciplinar da Unidade (Nutrição, Fisioterapia, Psicologia, Serviço Social e Médicos), trocando informações diversas e apresentando percepções e indicadores do paciente;
  • Intermediar situações conflituosas entre as equipes (de enfermagem e multiprofissionais), pacientes ou familiares, utilizando o bom senso e postura profissional, a fim de manter um ambiente harmonioso conforme a especificidade do Hospital;
  • Garantir informações precisas e seguras referentes aos cuidados realizados, tanto para os próximos plantões quanto aos outros setores que os pacientes serão encaminhados, por meio de evolução em formulário próprio, a fim de dar continuidade na assistência;
  • Realizar procedimentos invasivos de maior complexidade nos pacientes, tais como: cateterismo vesical, sonda nasogástrica ou nasoentérica, entre outros, aplicando técnicas específicas e utilizando EPIs recomendados, a fim de garantir a aplicação do procedimento definido conforme normas e regras da unidade;
  • Manter registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências diariamente, gerenciar o tempo de exames; Acolher os pacientes;
  • Realizar transporte de paciente crítico;
  • Realizar punção periférica jugular externa; Administrar medicação em acesso profundo;
  • Retirar medicamentos de alta vigilância; Realizar dimensionamento da equipe conforme fluxo da Emergência;
  • Efetuar a conferência diária dos desfibriladores, dos lacres do carro de parada e das maletas de transporte, garantindo o perfeito estado de funcionamento e prontidão dos mesmos;
  • Segregar o fluxo de pacientes com síndrome gripal;
  • Realizar acolhimento no atendimento inicial após 20min de espera, priorizando os protocolos e critérios de gravidade;
  • Realizar procedimentos técnicos e maior complexidade ou específicos do seu cargo, bem como supervisionar as atividades desenvolvidas pelo técnico de enfermagem;
  • Avaliar riscos, quedas, úlceras, broncoaspiração, PAV (pneumonia associada a ventilação mecânica);
  • Preenchimento dos Bundles clínicos de forma correta para garantir segurança do paciente;
  • Cumprir efetivamente com a análise de prontuários e demais documentos do setor, de modo a manter a fidedignidade das informações relativas aos cuidados dos pacientes, bem como relativos aos eventos de enfermagem, visando possibilitar uma assistência eficaz e de excelência.

Outras Informações

  • Local de trabalho: Glória/RJ.
  • Escala de trabalho: 12x36 - 07h às 19h.
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento.
